vulnerability_analysis: The CMOVE contract has an owner-only function addBlackList() that can blacklist any address. Once blacklisted, the _beforeTokenTransfer hook prevents any transfers involving that address, effectively freezing funds. This is a classic owner privilege abuse where the owner can arbitrarily restrict transfers for any address.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call addBlackList() to blacklist a victim address (the WBNB pair). Then verify that the address is indeed blacklisted.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call addBlackList() with the WBNB pair address as victim. 4. Verify the blacklist state is true.
